themes.name: Agentic AI in research

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content discussing AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Research and analysis specifically on the behavior, capabilities, and limitations of AI chatbots.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles about specific AI-powered platforms and software used for conducting research, analysis, and generating insights.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discussions and research on the creation and use of artificial or simulated users for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in user interface and user experience design, including tools and methodologies for AI-assisted design.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and articles exploring how AI is affecting jobs, employment, and the skills required in the workforce.

themes.name: AI summarization

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
